summary: Layer 1B expansion found one obvious context anchor and three underfollowed or semi-underfollowed US-listed candidates tied to nuclear-qualified components, radiation monitoring, flow-control hardware, and defense-nuclear crossover manufacturing. The strongest underfollowed fit in this pass is Flowserve because its nuclear pump, valve, seal, ASME Section III, N-stamp, NQA-1, and 10CFR qualification evidence maps directly to the node. Mirion maps to nuclear radiation monitoring, outage/regulatory safety, and instrumentation gates rather than heavy reactor parts. Graham is a smaller speculative-shadow candidate because its public materials show Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program components, but commercial nuclear exposure and qualification details require verification. BWXT remains the obvious reference anchor for nuclear components and fuel but is not the main discovery target.
